opening.argument: The report is grounded in identifiable political events and public statements. It covers Mamata Banerjee's meetings with opposition leaders, the Prime Minister, and Sonia Gandhi, including efforts to “prepare a coalition against BJP in the country.” It also reports her claims that “my phone has been hacked” and that “There is no freedom of press left.” The subject is explicitly identified as the West Bengal Chief Minister's Delhi tour, while the visible DB Live presenter and channel branding establish a conventional news presentation. References to membership, an app, and subscription function as ordinary channel access and audience engagement, without changing the report's news-oriented character.
